warp_flow: warp an image using an optical flow field with optional normalized coordinates
cat_imgflo: concatenate an image with its optical flow visualization as colored arrows
point_vec: draw arrow vectors on an image to visualize optical flow direction and magnitude
flow_to_image: convert an optical flow map into a Middlebury color-coded image for visualization
compute_color: compute a color-coded optical flow image from horizontal and vertical flow components
